page_title: NAN 1-3 STR | Nantes v Strasbourg 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Alban Lafont comes off his line to intercept the corner from Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Steven Baseya (Strasbourg) is replacing Lucas Perrin.
90+2' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg) replaces Emanuel Emegha.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Dilane Bakwa goes off and Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) comes on.
90+1' Eray Comert (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+1' Moses Simon (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Moses Simon (Nantes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
86' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
83' Yellow card. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
83' Moses Simon (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
80' Pedro Chirivella goes off the pitch and Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Mostafa Mohamed is going off and Jocelyn Gourvennec gives the last tactical orders to Matthis Abline (Nantes).
78' 1 - 3 Dilane Bakwa passes to Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
78' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kevin Gameiro as he is replaced by Rabby Inzingoula (Strasbourg).
75' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nantes.
75' The ball falls kindly for Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
72' Jocelyn Gourvennec decides to make a substitution. Florent Mollet will be replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
72' Here comes a substitution. Nathan Zeze is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes).
69' A rebound bounces out to Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
69' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
67' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
66' Substitution. Benie Traore (Nantes) in, Tino Kadewere out.
64' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

62' 1 - 2 Goal! Dilane Bakwa produces a great pass that finds Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
62' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
61' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
61' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
59' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
58' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
56' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
56' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
54' Total attempts – 9:4.

51' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
50' A lofted cross from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
49' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
49' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
48' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremie Pignard saw the whole situation.
46' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Alaa Bellaarouch comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
45+2' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is able to continue to play.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The game is interrupted now, Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
44' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
41' Nantes players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
38' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
36' 1 - 1 Goal! Eray Comert (Nantes) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
35' Florent Mollet (Nantes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
35' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' Moses Simon (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
31' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Florent Mollet (Nantes) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
29' A cross from the by-line finds Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
29' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Florent Mollet (Nantes).
24' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
23' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
20' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
14' One of the players from Nantes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
12' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) will take the corner.
11' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
10' Alaa Bellaarouch reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Florent Mollet (Nantes) towards the roof of the net.
8' The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
6' Nantes keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Marvin Senaya, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will officiate today.
